arrive.speaker: Morty
arrive.text: Home. Home, home, home. Okay. Now close the portal. How do you close the por-

faceOff.speaker: Shrimp Rick
faceOff.text: You took my fluid. Then the Citadel made me take a number. A NUMBER. So I'm taking your garage.

faceOff.speaker: Morty
faceOff.text: Rick! Rick, wake up! There's a shrimp you in the garage!

faceOff.speaker: Rick
faceOff.text: Zzzz... tell him... we gave at the office... zzzz.

faceOff.speaker: Morty
faceOff.text: Okay. Okay. I can do this. I can probably do this.

shoot.label: Shoot
shoot.desc: {dmg} damage. Hit SPACE when the rings meet for a critical hit.

shootCharged.label: Shoot  x2
shootCharged.desc: Charged: {dmg} damage. Hit SPACE when the rings meet for a critical hit.

banish.label: PORTAL BANISH!
banish.desc: Send him home. Do not miss the timing.

talk.label: Talk
talk.desc: One thing Morty can say works in each phase.

defend.label: Defend
defend.desc: Half damage this turn. The next shot hits double.

hints.block: SPACE as it hits to block

captions.shell: His shell will block the next shot.
captions.shellBlocked: The shot bounces off his shell.
captions.sauce: Cocktail sauce in Morty's eyes. The next shot is hard to aim.
captions.sauceMiss: Morty can't see a thing. The shot goes wide.
captions.defend: Morty braces. His next shot will hit double.
captions.soaked: The portal gun soaks up the whole slam.
captions.skip: Shrimp Rick just stares at the floor.
captions.rebels: Shrimp Rick is rattled. His attacks are weaker for 2 turns.
captions.banishReady: He's barely standing. The gun glows: PORTAL BANISH is ready!
captions.banishMiss: The portal fizzles out. So close.
captions.whistle: He whistles. Something very heavy answers.

rebels.speaker: Morty
rebels.text: Prawnsworth says hi. Not all of them like the parades.

rebels.speaker: Shrimp Rick
rebels.text: They LOVE the parades! Attendance is mandatory!

noRebels.speaker: Morty
noRebels.text: Your own shrimp don't even like you!

plea.speaker: Morty
plea.text: I don't even want to fight. I want to fix the gun and eat dinner with my family.

plea.speaker: Shrimp Rick
plea.text: ...Dinner. Mom used to make plankton on Sundays.

before.speaker: Shrimp Rick
before.text: Enough! I didn't want to do this in front of the lawn tools.

after.speaker: Shrimp Rick
after.text: Now we fight in my element. It's water. The element is water.

after.speaker: Morty
after.text: Why is it always shrimp? Why is it never something normal?

banish.speaker: Shrimp Rick
banish.text: This isn't over! I'm telling my mom!

ending.speaker: Morty
ending.text: I did it. Rick! I actually did it!

ending.speaker: Rick
ending.text: See, Morty? I handled it. Zzzz.

lose.speaker: Shrimp Rick
lose.text: Glory to the tank. And to me. Mostly me.

lines.speaker: Shrimp Rick
lines.text: Mom? ...Yes, I lost. ...To a boy. In a garage.

lines.speaker: Shrimp Rick
lines.text: No, I do NOT want cocktail sauce.
